content: दक्षिणा {%ind.%} .²1 On the right or south of. .²2 In the southern direction (with <ab>abl.</ab>) .{@-णा@} .²1 A present or gift to Brāhmaṇas (at the completion of a religious rite, such as a sacrifice). .²2 Dakṣiṇā regarded as a daughter of Prajāpati and as the wife of Sacrifice personified; पत्नी सुदक्षिणेत्यासीदध्वरस्येव दक्षिणा <ls>R. 1. 31</ls>. .²3 A gift, offering or donation in general, fee, remuneration; प्राणदक्षिणा, गुरुदक्षिणा <ab>&c.</ab>; <ab>cf.</ab> also दक्षिणाशब्दश्च परिक्रयार्थो भवति <ls>Ś. B. on MS. 10. 2. 38</ls> परिक्रयार्थे हि दक्षिणाशब्दो भवति <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 48</ls>. Etymologically दक्षिणा is so called because it imparts power or strength to the receiver; दक्षकरणी हि दक्षिणा . दक्षश्च बलम् . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 3. 45</ls>; दक्षिणा नाम दक्षतेरुत्साहकर्मणः . दक्षिणा उत्साहिका इति . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 3. 57</ls>. .²4 A good milch-cow, prolific cow. .²5 The south. .²6 The southern country, the Deccan. .²7 Fame. .²8 A kind of heroine thus defined:-- या गौरवं भयं प्रेम सद्भावं पूर्वनायके . न मुञ्चत्यन्यसक्तापि सा ज्ञेया दक्षिणा बुधैः ... .²9 Completion of any rite.
